inventory_items_paixao_clutch_only.name: inventory_items_paixao_clutch_only
inventory_items_paixao_clutch_only.value:
"inventory_items"."type" = 'clutch' or (
      "inventory_items"."rental_price" is null
      and "inventory_items"."replacement_value" is null
      and "inventory_items"."paixao_clutch_copy" is null
      and "inventory_items"."paixao_clutch_public_image_path" is null
      and "inventory_items"."paixao_clutch_slug" is null
      and "inventory_items"."paixao_clutch_published" = false
      and "inventory_items"."paixao_clutch_eligible" = false
      and "inventory_items"."paixao_clutch_featured" = false
      and "inventory_items"."paixao_clutch_sort_order" = 0
    )

inventory_items_paixao_clutch_publicatio.name: inventory_items_paixao_clutch_publication_valid
inventory_items_paixao_clutch_publicatio.value:
"inventory_items"."paixao_clutch_published" = false or (
      "inventory_items"."type" = 'clutch'
      and "inventory_items"."paixao_clutch_eligible" = true
      and "inventory_items"."active" = true
      and "inventory_items"."status" = 'available'
      and "inventory_items"."rental_price" is not null
      and nullif(btrim("inventory_items"."paixao_clutch_copy"), '') is not null
      and nullif(btrim("inventory_items"."paixao_clutch_public_image_path"), '') is not null
      and nullif(btrim("inventory_items"."paixao_clutch_slug"), '') is not null
      and "inventory_items"."paixao_clutch_slug" = btrim("inventory_items"."paixao_clutch_slug")
    )

inventory_reservations_reservation_conta.name: inventory_reservations_reservation_contact_valid
inventory_reservations_reservation_conta.value:
(
        "inventory_reservations"."purpose" = 'shoot'
        and "inventory_reservations"."shoot_id" is not null
        and "inventory_reservations"."guest_name" is null
        and "inventory_reservations"."guest_phone" is null
        and "inventory_reservations"."guest_email" is null
      ) or (
        "inventory_reservations"."purpose" = 'rental' and (
          ("inventory_reservations"."shoot_id" is not null and "inventory_reservations"."guest_name" is null and "inventory_reservations"."guest_phone" is null and "inventory_reservations"."guest_email" is null)
          or ("inventory_reservations"."shoot_id" is null and "inventory_reservations"."guest_name" is not null and "inventory_reservations"."guest_phone" is not null)
        )
      )

referrals_has_referred.name: referrals_has_referred
referrals_has_referred.value: "referrals"."referred_client_id" is not null or "referrals"."lead_id" is not null

reviews_completed_after_requested.name: reviews_completed_after_requested
reviews_completed_after_requested.value: "reviews"."requested_at" is null or "reviews"."completed_at" is null or "reviews"."completed_at" >= "reviews"."requested_at"
